user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with a very long guest name so that the system handles long string inputs gracefully.

positive.title: Successful booking with a long guest name
steps: Enter a guest name of 255 characters.
positive.expected_result: The booking is created successfully, and the guest name is displayed correctly in the confirmation message.

negative.title: Booking attempt with an empty guest name
steps: Leave the guest name field empty.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the guest name is required.

edge.title: Booking attempt with maximum allowed guest name length
steps: Enter a guest name with the maximum allowed characters (e.g., 256 characters).
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the guest name exceeds the maximum length allowed.
